title: Real-time Receipt Verification Platform (POS + Mobile App)
description: Built an end-to-end real-time receipt verification platform: a POS integration library that sends receipt data immediately after payment, and a mobile app that lets customers view verified receipts instantly.
case_overview: Retailers need a reliable way to verify receipts submitted from POS systems. I built an end-to-end **real-time receipt verification platform** that connects the **POS system** to a **receipt verification API** and provides an **auditor mobile app** for reviewing and verifying receipts in near real time.
case_components:
- **POS Integration Library**
  - Triggers on payment success
  - Maps POS data into a standardized receipt schema
  - Sends receipt data to the backend with reliability controls (retry/idempotency)

- **Receipt Verification API (Backend)**
  - Ingests and validates receipt payloads
  - Stores receipts and verification status (e.g., Pending / Verified / Rejected)
  - Exposes endpoints for the auditor app (list/detail/verify)
  - Maintains audit trail (who verified, when, decision)

- **Auditor Mobile App**
  - Receipt inbox/list with filters (date/store/status)
  - Receipt detail view (items, totals, store info, payment info)
  - Verify/Reject actions with notes/reasons (optional)
  - Designed for fast review and clear status visibility
case_team:
- **Mobile Developer** (Auditor app) — *Me*
- **POS/Integration Developer** (POS library + integration support) — *Me*
- **Backend Developer** (Receipt verification API)
- **QA** (SIT/UAT, regression testing)
case_outcome:
- Auditors can verify receipts **near real time** after payment
- POS onboarding became faster with a **reusable integration library**
- Improved consistency via a **standard receipt schema**
- Higher reliability using **retry + idempotency** to prevent duplicates
- Smoother releases through hands-on **SIT/UAT support**, faster bug turnaround, and clearer test validation

title: Promotion & Incentive (P&I) Web Application
description: Built a P&I web application to create promotions and calculate incentives using **dynamic formulas**, integrated with the **POS system**, and added **promotion performance tracking** plus **monthly accounting reports** to pay incentives to suppliers.
case_overview:
Promotions and incentives change frequently and require flexible calculation logic. Hardcoding rules slows down launches and increases maintenance. This P&I platform allows business teams to configure promotions and incentive rules through a web backoffice, while the system calculates incentives using a **config-driven formula engine**.  
  Beyond configuration and calculation, the platform provides **performance tracking** to evaluate which promotions are effective, and generates **monthly accounting reports** used to settle incentive payments with suppliers.
case_team:
- Web Developer (Frontend)
- Backend Developer (API, database, rule engine)
- POS/Integration Developer
- QA / Tester
- Product Owner / Business team / Accounting team
case_outcome:
- Faster promotion launch and changes without frequent code updates
- Reliable incentive calculation through a reusable **dynamic formula engine**
- Better decision-making via **promotion performance tracking** (identify high-performing promotions)
- Reduced accounting manual work with **monthly supplier incentive payout reports**
- Improved end-to-end stability through hands-on **SIT/UAT** and reconciliation testing

title: Partner Management System
description: Built a Partner Management System that helps partners manage store devices (status tracking and visibility) and coordinate internet device installation appointments with the platform owner through a structured scheduling workflow.
case_overview:
The Partner Management System is a platform designed to streamline partner operations in two critical areas: **device management** and **appointment coordination**.  
Partners need a clear view of devices deployed across their stores—what devices exist, where they are, and their current status. At the same time, they must coordinate **internet device installation appointments** with the platform owner efficiently. This system centralizes both workflows into one platform to reduce manual communication, improve visibility, and ensure smoother operations.

- **Device Management**
    - Partner dashboard to view devices by store/location
    - Device identification and inventory tracking
    - Device status monitoring (e.g., active/inactive/issue/pending) *(based on system design)*

- **Appointment Coordination**

    - Appointment list, detail view, and status tracking (requested/confirmed/rescheduled/completed) *(if applicable)*
    - Calendar/time-slot coordination and basic conflict validation *(if applicable)*
    - Notes/requirements capture for installation visits *(if applicable)*

- **Backend/API & Data**
    - Device and appointment APIs
    - Role-based access for partner users and platform owner teams *(if applicable)*
    - Audit logs for changes to device status and appointment updates *(optional)*

- Backend Developer (API/Database)
- QA / Tester
- Partner operations / Support

- Reduced manual coordination by introducing a structured appointment workflow
- Increased operational efficiency with centralized device + appointment management
- Improved stability and release readiness through SIT/UAT support and issue resolution
